name: SaaSPirate

sources.title: Submit Your SaaS — contact-style form (First Name, Email, Text Input, optional Affiliate Program URL, Message)
Submit a Deal — the deals-oriented submission entry linked in nav
Homepage — SaaS deals/reviews site running since 2019, 1,561+ verified deals

requirements: SaaS/software product; preferred categories include AI & automation tools, WordPress, cloud, marketing, design, business automation, productivity
Submission is a contact form: First Name, Email, a 'Text Input' field, optional Affiliate Program URL, and a message
Site suggests preparing complete product info, simple pricing, high-quality images, an update plan, and support docs
Separate form exists for Black Friday deals (/blackfriday-submit/)
preparation: Product name, URL, pricing details, key features, target users
Deal/discount details if you can offer one — the site centers on deals and lifetime offers
Affiliate program URL if you have one (optional field)
High-quality product images and support documentation references
workflow: Fill the contact form: name, email, product info in Text Input, optional affiliate URL, message
Submit and wait — their stated flow is 'get verified and added' after contact
If accepted, expect listing plus exposure via their newsletter and 7,100-member Facebook group
watchFor: Form is a generic contact form — there is no structured listing builder, so include full product details in the message
No pricing is stated for listing — pitch-style submission; any fees would be negotiated by email
Site is deals-oriented (lifetime deals, discounts) — submissions without a deal angle may be lower priority
Separate 'Submit a Deal' and Black Friday forms exist — pick the one matching your offer
Audience-supported site with affiliate disclosure — listings may carry affiliate framing
countsAsLive: Product appears as a deal/review page under saaspirate.com/deals/<slug> or is covered in a blog/interview post
unknowns: Whether listing is free or paid — not stated on public pages
What the unlabeled 'Text Input' field expects (likely product name or URL)
